title: AI Firm Nscale Faces Investor Pushback Over IPO Valuation
text: Bloomberg's Brody Ford said that issues facing the IPO of AI firm Nscale are 'endemic' to the larger AI data center industry as developers try to source power and labor and contend with potential delays. Bloomberg's Bailey Lipschultz said that the tone has shifted for AI IPOs as more companies slow down on going public before the end of the year.  (Source: Bloomberg)
